about: James W. Cobb is an attorney providing legal services covering Business Litigation, Appellate and General Litigation.

James Cobb, who practices law in Atlanta, Georgia, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at The George Washington University Law School. He graduated in 2005. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 2006.
